title: Copper Tundra: The Diplomat's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the mutual passage covenant; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
